title: Mount Fuji at Twilight
description: A majestic conical mountain dominates the composition, its slopes rendered in deep blues and purples with glowing pink highlights on the peak. Small clusters of white and cyan lights suggest a town or roads at its base, set against a colorful twilight sky with soft clouds and a glowing green atmospheric band.
prompt: A majestic conical mountain at twilight, slopes painted in rich deep blues and purples with glowing pink light catching the summit. Small clusters of white and cyan lights trace roads and settlements at the base. Dramatic colorful sky with soft clouds and a luminous green atmospheric band across the horizon, painterly brushwork, moody and serene atmosphere.
